card.name: Linking word before the word infection
card.fires_on: The small word "of" (or "to") right before "infection", mostly after "signs", "symptoms" or "risk" in warnings about low white blood cell counts.

modes.label: Signs of infection
modes.description: "of" after "signs" or "symptoms" in monitoring instructions for patients with neutropenia.

modes.label: Risk or susceptibility
modes.description: "of" or "to" after "risk" or "susceptibility" when low blood counts raise infection chances.

card.plain: It fires on the little word before "infection" in phrases like "signs of infection" and "risk of infection".
